_about: PROPOSED seeds for the Facebook rentals lane (facebook-rentals.ts). Not read by the lane: its live seeds sit in scripts/crm/.data/fb-rentals/seeds.json (gitignored), which only `seeds --add` writes. Facebook was not scraped to build this — group IDs come from public search results; groups with url=null were found by name only. A human resolves and checks each one on the DEDICATED scrape account (it must already be a member / see the posts; the bot never searches or joins), then promotes it.
_promote: pnpm crm:fb-rentals-seeds --add=<url>[,<url>…]   # group (https://www.facebook.com/groups/…) or Marketplace (https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/…) URLs only; then: pnpm crm:fb-rentals capture --limit=1 --probe
_resolve: For a url=null entry: on the scrape account open the `find` link, pick the group whose name matches, check it is about Kigali rentals and active this week, join if needed, and copy its https://www.facebook.com/groups/<id-or-slug>/ URL into --add.

seeds.name: Facebook Marketplace — Kigali property rentals
seeds.evidence: Marketplace's standard /marketplace/<city>/propertyrentals path; the lane's parser already reads Marketplace listings (marketplace_listing_title). Check the city slug resolves to Kigali on the scrape account.

seeds.name: Facebook Marketplace — search "house for rent" in Kigali
seeds.evidence: Marketplace search URL; broker posts in English.

seeds.name: Facebook Marketplace — search "inzu ikodeshwa" (Kinyarwanda: house for rent) in Kigali
seeds.evidence: The Kinyarwanda phrase owners use (the TikTok lane's top captions, rw.zimcompass.com's own title 'Inzu Ikodeshwa').

seeds.name: Facebook Marketplace — search "apartment for rent" in Kigali
Expats in Kigali
seeds.evidence: Group ID from a publicly indexed post URL (facebook.com/groups/472643917304110/posts/…); listed as a Kigali expat community on nomad.watch. Mixed topics — rentals are a share of posts, so the lane's rental-text gate does the filtering.

seeds.name: Living in Kigali (Expats) Rwanda
seeds.evidence: Named on nomad.watch's Kigali communities list; livinginkigali.com (38k-like Page) sends house hunters to its Facebook community and says it vets advertisers.

seeds.name: Expats in Kigali (Living Rwanda) House Buy & Sale
seeds.evidence: Named on nomad.watch as the housing group among Kigali's expat groups. Sale posts are dropped by the lane's rental gate.

seeds.name: Expats Living And Working In Kigali
seeds.evidence: Named on nomad.watch's Kigali communities list.

seeds.name: Expats in Rwanda
seeds.evidence: Startup Guide's Kigali cost-of-living page names 'Expats in Rwanda' and 'Living in Kigali' as where to start a room search.

seeds.name: House for rent in Kigali
seeds.evidence: The common group name for broker posts; several groups share it — keep the one with daily posts and RWF prices.

seeds.name: Inzu zikodeshwa Kigali
seeds.evidence: Kinyarwanda 'houses for rent' — the hashtag behind most of the TikTok lane's seeds; owner-direct posts, the supply the English groups miss.

seeds.name: Kigali Real Estate (rent & sale)
seeds.evidence: Agency-heavy; pick the group whose posts are rentals with prices, skip land/sale-only ones.

notSeedable._why: Facebook Pages, not groups — the lane reads only /groups/ and /marketplace/ URLs. Their stock reaches the CRM another way.
